display.purpose: NEOZUO identity only; mobile override is 23.1vw.

title.purpose: Base subordinate heading with component-specific size variants.

introduction.purpose: Companion copy around the identity monument.

body.purpose: Korean explanatory text with keep-all word breaking.

motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Button color and press, and stage-choice color transitions.

motion.name: link-arrow-transition
motion.purpose: Four-pixel forward movement on text-link hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables animations/transitions and smooth scrolling; removes hover arrow translation.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The standard inquiry action with the source hover, focus, and press states.
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 24px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius,3px);background:var(--blue,#254bdf);color:var(--white,#fff);font-size:var(--body,18px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out;}.ds-button svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-button:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-button:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--blue-dark,#1733ad)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: The light secondary action with pale mint hover and ink text.
components.css: .ds-ghost{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 24px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius,3px);background:var(--blue,#254bdf);color:var(--white,#fff);font-size:var(--body,18px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out;background:var(--surface,#e9eeed);color:var(--ink,#182126)}.ds-ghost:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-ghost:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-ghost:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--blue-dark,#1733ad)}.ds-ghost:not(:disabled):hover{background:var(--mint,#dbe8df);color:var(--ink,#182126)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-ghost{transition:none}}

components.name: Text link
components.description: Inline directional navigation with restrained arrow motion.
components.html: 이 내용으로 문의하기
components.css: .ds-link{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;min-height:44px;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue,#254bdf);text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-link svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;transition:transform 180ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1))}.ds-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-link:hover svg{transform:translateX(4px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-link svg{transition:none}.ds-link:hover svg{transform:none}}

components.name: Inquiry field
components.description: Visible Korean label and high-contrast field on the dark inquiry surface.
components.css: .ds-field-panel{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:24px;background:var(--dark,#172126);color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-field-label{display:block;font-size:16px;font-weight:550;line-height:1.65}.ds-field-label span{font-size:14px;font-weight:400}.ds-field{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:block;margin-top:10px;background:#26353d;color:var(--white,#fff);border:1px solid #65767f;border-radius:var(--radius,3px);padding:12px 14px;width:calc(100% - 30px);font-size:18px;line-height:1.6;min-height:24px;font-weight:400;caret-color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-field:focus{outline:2px solid var(--white,#fff);outline-offset:3px}

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Light navigation keeps the inquiry action visible when supporting links hide.
components.html:
neozuo.
서비스사례프로젝트 문의
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:20px;min-height:96px;background:var(--paper,#f7f8f7);color:var(--ink,#182126);padding-inline:var(--gutter,20px)}.ds-logo{font-size:28px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-logo span{color:var(--blue,#254bdf)}.ds-nav-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:32px}.ds-nav-links a{font-size:16px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.ds-nav-links .ds-nav-cta{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:24px;min-height:52px;padding:14px 24px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius,3px);background:var(--blue,#254bdf);color:var(--white,#fff);font-size:var(--body,18px);font-weight:600;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,transform 160ms ease-out;min-height:24px;padding:11px 18px;font-size:16px}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-nav-links a:not(.ds-nav-cta):hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav-cta:active{transform:scale(.98)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-nav-links .ds-nav-cta:hover{background:var(--blue-dark,#1733ad)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-nav{min-height:76px}.ds-logo{font-size:25px}.ds-nav-links>a:not(.ds-nav-cta){display:none}.ds-nav-links .ds-nav-cta{font-size:14px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav-cta{transition:none}}

components.name: Stage choice
components.description: Native radio choices combine whole-row focus with a visible selected check.
components.html: 프로젝트의 현재 상황
components.css: .ds-choices{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;display:grid;gap:8px;border:0;margin:0;padding:0}.ds-choice-legend{font-size:16px;margin-bottom:12px}.ds-choice{display:flex;position:relative;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;background:var(--surface,#e9eeed);color:var(--ink,#182126);padding:19px 24px;cursor:pointer;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,21px);line-height:1.45;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,color 160ms ease-out}.ds-choice input{position:absolute;opacity:0;width:1px;height:1px}.ds-choice svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;visibility:hidden}.ds-choice:has(:checked){background:var(--blue,#254bdf);color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-choice:has(:checked) svg{visibility:visible}.ds-choice:has(:focus-visible){outline:3px solid var(--blue,#254bdf);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-choice:not(:has(:checked)):hover{background:#dce2e0}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-choice{padding:17px 16px;font-size:17px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-choice{transition:none}}

기존 프로젝트의 구현 범위와 경험을 소개합니다.

사례 자세히 보기
components.css: .ds-project{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:clamp(28px,4vw,64px);background:var(--light-blue,#dfe6ff);color:var(--ink,#182126);font-size:var(--body,18px);line-height:1.65;word-break:keep-all}.ds-project h3{font-size:clamp(30px,3.7vw,54px);line-height:1.23;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 22px}.ds-project p{color:var(--muted,#4c575c);max-width:40ch;margin:20px 0 0}.ds-project a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;margin-top:32px;font-weight:600;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-project a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-project a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}@media(max-width:1000px){.ds-project h3{font-size:36px}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-project{padding:28px}.ds-project h3{font-size:32px}}

components.description: Native disclosure with a tonal open state.
components.html:
기획서가 없어도 문의할 수 있나요?

네. 아이디어와 해결하고 싶은 문제만 있어도 괜찮습니다.
components.css: .ds-faq{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;padding:20px 24px;background:var(--paper,#f7f8f7);color:var(--ink,#182126)}.ds-faq[open]{background:var(--surface,#e9eeed)}.ds-faq summary{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:clamp(18px,1.5vw,22px);font-weight:550;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:6px;}.ds-faq svg{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}.ds-faq[open] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}.ds-faq p{margin:0;padding-top:20px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#4c575c);max-width:50ch}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-faq{padding:20px 12px}.ds-faq summary{font-size:18px;gap:12px}.ds-faq svg{width:20px;height:20px}}

components.css: .ds-monument-field{font-family:"Pretendard Subset", "Pretendard Variable", Pretendard, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", sans-serif;background:var(--blue,#254bdf);color:var(--white,#fff);padding:30px 20px;overflow:hidden}.ds-monument{font-size:clamp(80px,23.4vw,360px);font-weight:800;line-height:.96;letter-spacing:-.04em;white-space:nowrap;margin-left:-.012em}@media(min-width:1600px){.ds-monument{font-size:360px}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-monument{font-size:23.1vw}}

narrative.overview:
The name itself supplies the visual identity: large, tightly set NEOZUO lettering anchors broad cobalt and charcoal fields. Korean text stays plain and calm around that scale contrast. The result is confident without requiring decorative imagery or invented product screenshots.

Content surfaces use off-white and cool neutral fills, generous sectional space, and readable text blocks. Controls remain visibly functional, with native radio choices, disclosure rows, and labeled form fields. The document records the built system in styles.css, index.html, and site.js; page sequencing remains in the surface brief.
keyCharacteristics: Monumental brand type with quiet explanatory copy.
Cobalt identity fields and actions, cool neutral reading surfaces.
Flat rectangular panels and minimally softened controls.
Korean-first typography, native semantics, and restrained state motion.

rules.name: The Cobalt Anchor Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for identity fields, primary actions, and selected choices. Keep long reading passages on paper, neutral, or dark surfaces.

rules.name: The Name Carries Scale Rule
rules.body: Reserve the monumental display treatment for the NEOZUO wordmark; explanatory Korean headings use the smaller headline and title roles.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate content through fill, spacing, and type hierarchy. The built system has no box shadows.

dos: Do keep Korean words together and use balanced heading wraps with readable explanatory line lengths.
Do use the existing cobalt, paper, neutral, and dark surface relationships.
Do preserve native labels, radio selection, disclosure behavior, visible focus, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep project imagery factual; use clearly captioned schematic diagrams when demonstrating a workflow.
Do retain the display wordmark as a brand signature while scaling functional text independently.
donts: Don't introduce decorative gradients, floating card shadows, or pill-shaped versions of these rectangular surfaces.
Don't turn every heading into monumental display type.
Don't replace visible form labels or native controls with decorative approximations.
Don't use stock photography, fabricated screenshots, client logos, testimonials, or result metrics as proof without approved source material.
